[[Ancient Effigy|Ancient Effigies]] are [[elemental]] [[construct]]s created to serve as [[elementalist]]s in [[Zoldark the Unholy]]'s personal [[Undead]] army phalanx. Ancient Effigies are very resilient and use high damage [[AoE]] spells.

==Notes==
* Ancient Effigies respawn after they are killed.
* Similar to most Elementals, Ancient Effigies are not [[fleshy]] and do not suffer extra damage from [[holy damage]] sources.
*They are vulnerable to [[of Deathbane]] weapon modifiers as they are part of the [[undead]] army, but they only trigger [[Edge of Extinction]] for elemental creatures.
